description: Parameter barcodes for Zebra/Symbol SSI scanners, decoded from the barcodes printed in the vendor's own configuration guide rather than transcribed from its tables, and re-encoded to confirm each one round-trips unchanged. Categories are numbered because they are ordered by consequence rather than alphabetically: recovery first, then whether the scanner will accept further programming at all, then what it types into the host, then how much it will decode. Parameter numbers and values differ between product families and firmware revisions -- check a code against the guide for your exact model before scanning it at hardware you care about.
